name: afa-recherche
title: recherche.histoirerurale.ch (MCP)
description: MCP server for recherche.histoirerurale.ch — the research portal of the Archives of Rural History (Archiv für Agrargeschichte, AfA). Full-text search over persons, institutions, farms, audiovisual sources, archive holdings, digital editions (Mina Hofstetter, Augusta Gillabert-Randin, Elizabeth Bobbett), publications and media reports in German, French, Italian and English.
